_readme: Single source of truth for the guided tour (js/tour.js) and the audio generator (scripts/generate-tour-audio.mjs). Clips play in this order. Audio for each clip is assets/tour/{id}.mp3. target: what the tour scrolls to. ring: what stays bright while the rest of the page gently dims (defaults to target; false = no highlight, used for the hero). wait: pause until the visitor hovers/clicks, or the timeout. playIf: 'interacted' plays only if the previous wait was answered. only: 'highlights' keeps a clip out of the full tour. speech (optional): different text for the voice, if the caption reads badly aloud.

clips.caption: Hey! I'm Tanishka's AI guide. Short on time? Here are the highlights in under a minute.
Hey! I'm Tanishka's AI guide. The real Tanishka is probably debugging something right now, so I'm showing you around.
First, move your cursor over her photo. Go on, I'll wait.
See? Black and white to full colour. That's basically what she does with data.
She started in data analytics and picked up one rule: never trust a number you haven't checked. That rule still runs every AI system she builds.
Now the fun part. Each of these darkroom doors hides one of her skill areas. Pick any door. Go on, they don't bite.
Good pick. Have a peek inside. I'll show you her two favourites next.

Behind the AI door: 3Rings, the product she's leading for a US company. It turns a creator's YouTube, Instagram and TikTok numbers into advice they can actually use. And that Visit site button? It's live. Go explore it after the tour.

And behind the machine learning door, her favourite: a chatbot that can tell how you're feeling, built for people facing cyberbullying. Ninety-five percent accuracy and two first prizes. Not bad for a chatbot with feelings.
Want the origin story? Watch the year roll back, from leading a product in 2026 to a classroom in Jaipur in 2023.
A few trophies, some certifications, and a 9.8 CGPA. Pretty hard to argue with.
That's the tour! If anything caught your eye, her inbox is right here, and she usually replies within a day. Thanks for visiting.
